sloka: विमानैर्बहुभिर्लङ्क सम्कीर्णा रचिता पुरा ।विष्णोः पदमिवाकाशम् चादितम् पाण्डुभिर्घनैः ॥६-२४-१०॥।।
transliteration: vimānairbahubhirlaṅka samkīrṇā racitā purā ।viṣṇoḥ padamivākāśam cāditam pāṇḍubhirghanaiḥ ॥6-24-10॥।।

translations.english: "This Lanka appears splendid with a mass of skyscrapers like white clouds covering the path of Vishnu in the sky."
